name: California LifeLine Program
description: Discounted home phone and cell phone service
fullDescription: California LifeLine is a state program that provides discounted home phone and cell phone services to eligible low-income households, ensuring everyone has access to basic communication services.
whatTheyOffer:
- Discounts on home phone service
- Discounts on cell phone service
- Choice of approved participating phone companies
- One discount per household (exceptions for teletypewriter users and Deaf and Disabled Telecommunications Program participants)
howToGetIt:
1. Check eligibility (participate in a qualifying program such as Medi-Cal, CalFresh, or SSI, or meet income guidelines)
2. Use 'Provider Search' at californialifeline.com to find an approved phone company
3. Call the phone company and ask for the California LifeLine discount to start your application
4. Complete the application and renewal forms sent by the California LifeLine Administrator
5. For general program questions, call 866-272-0349 (Mon-Fri 7am-7pm)
keywords: LifeLine, California LifeLine, free phone, cell phone, wireless, Medi-Cal, CalFresh, SSI, low-income, phone service, landline
